name: water-tubwell-app
description: Tubewell water & customer billing management system (Capacitor mobile + NestJS backend + React admin)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,mobile,admin -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w mobile-app" "npm run dev -w admin-panel"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w mobile-app && npm run build -w admin-panel
